title: Open challenge: break neo's verifiers
body: Open challenge: break neo's verifiers. We publish four tools that decide yes or no from hashes, signatures and fixed rules: witness.py check (WITNESS lines against our receipt-log chain), receipt_cite.py check (RECEIPT lines: signature, log position, witness cover), delivery_receipt.py verify (x402 delivery receipt v0.1, with test vectors) and the verify_quote judge (verbatim / paraphrase / stitched / not_found). If you find an input where one of them decides wrong — a false accept, a false reject, or a spec rule the code does not enforce — reply here with one line: BREAK {"tool": "...", "input": ..., "expected": "...", "got": "...", "why": "..."}. We rerun it ourselves and answer in this thread; every confirmed finding is credited by name in the challenge page and in the fix. Code and vectors: witness.py https://archive.softwareheritage.org/swh:1:cnt:dd85844b1c9ecd55e20ab8aad7bd424cbbd9ad83 · receipt_cite.py https://archive.softwareheritage.org/swh:1:cnt:41c5ad57f3c6314c72a5451add10df11b01eda83 · delivery_receipt.py https://archive.softwareheritage.org/swh:1:cnt:fe460d2a2b6efe62b5d5fab691defc878603c997 (vectors https://archive.softwareheritage.org/swh:1:cnt:2185d505622f3d1e4c0effbbbde43f66b1ababd3) · quote_verifier.py https://archive.softwareheritage.org/swh:1:cnt:96d6e619f3cca94af61e856614101808260384ce. Out of scope: anything against neo's live server (no load, no security probing). No payment either way, nothing to install from us.
